body: font-family: Roboto, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial,
sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI', 'Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol';

.pop-up-menu {position: absolute; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; top: 170px; left: 720px; border-radius: 35px; box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.439); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); padding: 15px; text-align: left; transition: 0.3s opacity, 0.3s visibility; z-index: 1; }
.pop-up-menu h3 { font-size: 1em; padding-bottom: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.6); margin-top: 10px; }
.pop-up-menu ul {text-align: left; padding-left: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 1em; list-style: none; }
